\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 192-193 — a first pass}

\label{lesson:LA-R196-first-pass-words-from-chapters-192-193}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for a grove and a sacred grove.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item a crab, a sparrow, a stork, an owl, a peacock
  \item a drum, a knucklebone; an ankle, a gaming die; a token, a bracelet, a necklace
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
A crab? (\textbf{cancer, cancrī}.) A sparrow? (\textbf{passer, passeris}.) A stork? (\textbf{cicōnia, cicōniae}.) An owl? (\textbf{noctua, noctuae}.) A peacock? (\textbf{pāvō, pāvōnis}.) A drum? (\textbf{tympanum, tympanī}.) A knucklebone; an ankle? (\textbf{tālus, tālī}.) A gaming die; a token? (\textbf{tessera, tesserae}.) A bracelet? (\textbf{armilla, armillae}.) A necklace? (\textbf{monīle, monīlis}.)
\end{tcolorbox}

  \item a cake, vinegar, fish sauce, a ham, a birthday
  \item a running stream, a marsh, a meadow, a grove, a sacred grove

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
An opinion; a sentence? (\textbf{sententia, sententiae}.) Conversation? (\textbf{sermō, sermōnis}.) A speech? (\textbf{ōrātiō, ōrātiōnis}.) A rumour? (\textbf{rūmor, rūmōris}.) History? (\textbf{historia, historiae}.) A cake? (\textbf{lībum, lībī}.) Vinegar? (\textbf{acētum, acētī}.) Fish sauce? (\textbf{garum, garī}.) A ham? (\textbf{perna, pernae}.) A birthday? (\textbf{diēs nātālis, diēī nātālis}.) A running stream? (\textbf{fluvius, fluviī}.) A marsh? (\textbf{palūs, palūdis}.) A meadow? (\textbf{prātum, prātī}.) A grove? (\textbf{nemus, nemoris}.) A sacred grove? (\textbf{lūcus, lūcī}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
